name: Celiac Scout
tagline: A restaurant safety checker for people with celiac disease or a serious gluten intolerance.
description: A restaurant safety checker for people with celiac disease or a serious gluten intolerance. When you name a restaurant, chain, or menu item (or ask for safe options in an area), it vets it for celiac safety and gives a clear verdict.
